NASA Commercial Crew Program Press Kit, SpaceX Falcon 9 technical overview — dimensions

SpaceX’s Block 5 booster, designed for ten flights without refurbishment. The first orbital-class rocket to land and re-fly itself, fundamentally reshaping the commercial-launch market and dropping the cost-to-orbit by roughly an order of magnitude.
USA-277 — 780 days on orbit, KSC Shuttle Landing Facility
First privately-funded mission to reach the Moon; first Israeli lunar mission
First all-civilian orbital spaceflight; raised $243M for St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
First demonstration of kinetic-impactor planetary defense; first time humans moved an asteroid
First commercial spacewalk; highest Earth orbit by humans since Apollo 17 (1408 km)
ESA's follow-up to DART — surveying the deflected Didymos asteroid
USSF reusable robotic spaceplane — multi-year classified orbital missions, the only US spaceplane operational after the Shuttle's retirement
Launched Apollo 8, 9 and 11–17 (Apollo 9 in Earth orbit; Apollo 10 flew from 39B); today flies Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Crew Dragon
Heavy-lift backbone of the Chinese space program
Heavy lift for Artemis lunar program
Nine engines, one booster, flown and re-flown dozens of times
